reason: Three free months costs me nothing, and a lot of my wine bar guests are tourists who'd probably rather tap Apple Pay than wait for the terminal, so I'll put the QR codes out and watch. But the day the 59 lari starts, it has to have brought back regulars or I cancel.
objection: Will my guests really pay by QR instead of handing over a card or cash? On top of that, the payment partner's per-transaction fee comes on top of what I already pay my terminal, and nobody has told me the number.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free months less than about a fifth of tables pay by QR, or the transaction fee is higher than my bank terminal's, I drop it.
